## 8b70863caead

**Reproduced generator-contract defect — advertised valid values can produce
rule-invalid inputs.** Audited generator SHA-256:
`b54c9e6100f33bf0914d7daf782b59bc7f568877c36ce64f5b45fc84ab1c4987`;
executed canonical rule hash: `d8124c3abf4b`.

`AXES["texture"]["valid"]` advertises `no_motifs`, `single_motif`, and
`all_same_color` as ordinary valid values. All three are accepted, but the
resulting grids violate the generator's own invariant of exactly two isolated
objects: `self_check` reports 0, 1, and 3 objects respectively. The minimal
`texture=no_motifs` input also makes the canonical Racket rule fail with a
`take` contract violation because it contains no objects. A normal generated
baseline input executes successfully under the same rule and source hashes.

The same exact-source probe finds broader API/axis drift:

- all five tested advertised axis pairs (`n`, `palette_kind`, `palette_size`,
  `n_distinct_colors`, and helpful `texture`) are pixel-identical to one another
  and to the no-override baseline;
- four values inside the documented `grid_h`/`grid_w` valid ranges are rejected
  by the actual easy-band draw bounds;
- all seven tested invalid public call arguments are accepted, including Boolean,
  float, and string seeds, negative/string indices, and invalid difficulty values;
- all five tested unknown or invalid overrides are silently accepted and ignored.

The isolated defect linter independently flags one blocking
`texture-domain-overlap` issue and 170 warnings: 166 `strict-scalar`, four
`texture-dead`, and one overlap finding. No task-local tests or semantic contract
were available in the combined audit. A full override-contract attempt was
interrupted after 71,000/73,260 draws with thousands of findings, so no completed
override-stage verdict is claimed.

Reproducer and source-bound evidence:

- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/probe.py`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/summary.json`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/counterexample.json`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/input-no_motifs.json`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/racket-no_motifs.json`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead/racket-valid.json`
- `checks/audit/8b70863caead-defect-lint/checks/8b70863caead_audit_defect_lint.log`

This was audit-only work; the target source was not edited.
